about.purpose.1: Euro Stablecoin Exposure Monitor is an independent university project (ESCP Business School, economics and finance) by Lorenzo Bianchi. It takes ECB Working Paper No 3199, "Stablecoins and monetary policy transmission" (March 2026), as its reference.
about.purpose.2: It does three things: it estimates a range for the dollar stablecoins held by euro area residents; it describes which national banking systems, and which banks, have the funding most exposed to a substitution of deposits; and it computes, for any level of adoption, the effect on deposits, wholesale funding and credit. Every figure comes with its limits, and the scenarios are assumptions, not forecasts.
about.independent: The project is independent. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or produced for the ECB, the ESM, the EBA or any other institution whose data or papers it uses, and it uses none of their logos or visual identities.
about.sources.text: All data come from public sources, free of charge and without access keys. Each remains under its provider's terms of use; this application publishes only aggregates and indicators computed from them. The status of each source at the last update is in "Method and data".
about.src.ecb: European Central Bank: bank balance sheets (BSI), consolidated banking data, reference exchange rate, consumer surveys, Working Paper 3199
about.src.ecb.use: Funding structure, scenarios, level estimate, credit coefficients
about.src.ecb.terms: Source: ECB. Reuse with attribution under the ECB's terms.
about.src.eba: European Banking Authority: 2025 EU-wide transparency exercise
about.src.eba.terms: Source: EBA. Public bank-level data, not supervisory data.
about.src.eurostat: Eurostat: population and households; GISCO country boundaries
about.src.bis: Bank for International Settlements: locational banking statistics
about.src.bis.terms: Source: BIS. Reuse with attribution under the BIS's terms.
about.src.esm.terms: Published paper, cited as an external assumption.
about.src.market: DefiLlama and CoinGecko; public APIs of 24 exchanges
about.src.market.terms: Public endpoints, each under its provider's terms; only weekly aggregates are published here.
about.licences.text: The application is static: it runs in the browser, sends no data anywhere and sets no cookies. It is built with the following open-source components.
about.lic.fonts: Typefaces: Source Serif 4 (titles), Inter (text and figures)
about.lic.ui: Interface and build: React, Vite, TypeScript
about.repo.text: The specification (SPEC.md), the numbered reports and DATA_SOURCES.md document every decision, test, discarded method and the terms of use of each dataset.
